standard: General effluent discharge limits for inland surface water

measures.name: ph
measures.label: pH
measures.description: Acidity or alkalinity of the sample.
measures.treatment_if_measure_below_lower_bound: Confirm the pH measurement and assess controlled alkali neutralisation using titration and compatibility testing; retest after treatment.
measures.treatment_if_measure_above_upper_bound: Confirm the pH measurement and assess controlled acid neutralisation using titration and compatibility testing; retest after treatment. Do not acidify cyanide- or sulphide-bearing waste.

measures.name: bod5
measures.label: BOD5
measures.description: Biochemical oxygen demand over a 5-day incubation.
measures.treatment_if_measure_below_lower_bound: A negative BOD5 is not physically possible. Discard the result, re-check the dilution and the seeded blank, and repeat the 5-day incubation.
measures.treatment_if_measure_above_upper_bound: Assess biodegradability and biological inhibition before selecting an MBBR, SBR or activated-sludge process. Segregate toxic chemical waste and evaluate equalisation. For an existing biological plant, investigate dissolved oxygen, biomass condition and loading before changing operating settings.

measures.name: cod
measures.label: COD
measures.description: Chemical oxygen demand, including matter that the biology cannot digest.
measures.treatment_if_measure_below_lower_bound: A negative COD is not physically possible. Re-run the digestion with a fresh blank and verify the potassium dichromate standard.
measures.treatment_if_measure_above_upper_bound: Determine whether the COD is biodegradable or refractory. Evaluate biological treatment for biodegradable material and activated carbon or advanced oxidation for suitable refractory compounds. Validate removal and oxidation by-products through treatability testing.

measures.name: tss
measures.label: Total suspended solids
measures.description: Dry weight of particles retained by the filter.
measures.treatment_if_measure_below_lower_bound: A negative solids result is not physically possible. Re-dry and re-weigh the filter, and check the balance against a known mass.
measures.treatment_if_measure_above_upper_bound: Evaluate settling and filtration; use coagulation and flocculation where fine particles do not settle adequately. Select coagulant and dose through jar tests and provide sludge collection.

measures.name: dissolved_oxygen
measures.label: Dissolved oxygen
measures.description: Free oxygen available in the sample.
measures.treatment_if_measure_below_lower_bound: Increase blower output or diffuser coverage in the aeration basin and clean or replace fouled diffusers. Reduce the organic load reaching the basin. Low dissolved oxygen drives filamentous bulking, so check the sludge volume index once oxygen recovers.
measures.treatment_if_measure_above_upper_bound: The basin is over-aerated. Confirm the probe calibration, then trim the dissolved oxygen setpoint or turn the blowers down. Beyond the wasted energy, excess aeration shears the floc and worsens settling.

measures.name: oil_and_grease
measures.label: Oil and grease
measures.description: Hexane-extractable fats, oils and grease.
measures.treatment_if_measure_below_lower_bound: A negative extractable result is not physically possible. Re-extract the sample with fresh solvent and re-weigh the dried flask.
measures.treatment_if_measure_above_upper_bound: Skim the grease trap and the dissolved air flotation unit and shorten the skimming interval. Verify the DAF air-to-solids ratio and coagulant dose, and fit an upstream oil-water separator if the load is continuous. Never route skimmings back to the head of works.

measures.name: tds
measures.label: TDS
measures.description: TDS in the wastewater sample; use the stated reporting basis.
measures.treatment_if_measure_below_lower_bound: A negative reported value is invalid for this assessment. Review blanks, calibration, calculations, and reporting with the laboratory; obtain a valid result before assessment.
measures.treatment_if_measure_above_upper_bound: Identify the dissolved ions and segregate concentrated salt waste. Evaluate reverse osmosis or electrodialysis with suitable pretreatment and a disposal route for the concentrate.

measures.name: arsenic_total
measures.label: Arsenic (As)
measures.description: Arsenic (As) in the wastewater sample; use the stated reporting basis.
measures.treatment_if_measure_below_lower_bound: A negative reported value is invalid for this assessment. Review blanks, calibration, calculations and reporting with the laboratory; obtain a valid result before assessment.
measures.treatment_if_measure_above_upper_bound: Determine arsenic speciation. Evaluate iron-based adsorption or coagulation and filtration; evaluate conversion of As(III) where required. Manage arsenic-bearing media and sludge appropriately.

measures.name: cadmium_total
measures.label: Cadmium (Cd)
measures.description: Cadmium (Cd) in the wastewater sample; use the stated reporting basis.
measures.treatment_if_measure_below_lower_bound: A negative reported value is invalid for this assessment. Review blanks, calibration, calculations and reporting with the laboratory; obtain a valid result before assessment.
measures.treatment_if_measure_above_upper_bound: Evaluate chemical precipitation with solid separation, followed by selective ion exchange or adsorption if polishing is required. Check metal speciation and complexing agents, determine operating conditions through treatability tests, and manage metal-bearing sludge and spent media appropriately.

measures.name: chromium_total
measures.label: Total chromium (Cr)
measures.description: Total chromium (Cr) in the wastewater sample; use the stated reporting basis.
measures.treatment_if_measure_below_lower_bound: A negative reported value is invalid for this assessment. Review blanks, calibration, calculations, and reporting with the laboratory; obtain a valid result before assessment.
measures.treatment_if_measure_above_upper_bound: Measure hexavalent chromium separately; total chromium alone does not establish speciation. Evaluate reduction where Cr(VI) is present, followed by precipitation and filtration, with polishing if needed.

measures.name: chromium_hexavalent
measures.label: Hexavalent chromium (Cr⁶⁺)
measures.description: Hexavalent chromium (Cr⁶⁺) in the wastewater sample; use the stated reporting basis.
measures.treatment_if_measure_below_lower_bound: A negative reported value is invalid for this assessment. Review blanks, calibration, calculations and reporting with the laboratory; obtain a valid result before assessment.
measures.treatment_if_measure_above_upper_bound: Use a separate validated Cr(VI) measurement. Evaluate controlled chemical reduction to Cr(III), followed by precipitation and solid separation. Verify both total chromium and Cr(VI) after treatment.

measures.treatment_if_measure_below_lower_bound: A negative reported value is invalid for this assessment. Review blanks, calibration, calculations and reporting with the laboratory; obtain a valid result before assessment.
measures.treatment_if_measure_above_upper_bound: Evaluate chemical precipitation with solid separation, followed by selective ion exchange or adsorption if polishing is required. Check metal speciation and complexing agents, determine operating conditions through treatability tests, and manage metal-bearing sludge and spent media appropriately.

measures.label: Iron (Fe)

measures.treatment_if_measure_below_lower_bound: A negative reported value is invalid for this assessment. Review blanks, calibration, calculations and reporting with the laboratory; obtain a valid result before assessment.
measures.treatment_if_measure_above_upper_bound: Determine dissolved and particulate iron. Evaluate oxidation of dissolved Fe(II) where needed, followed by precipitation and filtration; monitor final pH.

measures.treatment_if_measure_above_upper_bound: Evaluate chemical precipitation with solid separation, followed by selective ion exchange or adsorption if polishing is required. measures.treatment_if_measure_below_lower_bound: A negative reported value is invalid for this assessment. Review blanks, calibration, calculations, and reporting with the laboratory; obtain a valid result before assessment.
measures.treatment_if_measure_above_upper_bound: Segregate mercury-bearing laboratory waste. Evaluate mercury-selective sorbents or specialist precipitation through treatability testing and arrange authorized disposal of mercury-bearing residues.

measures.treatment_if_measure_below_lower_bound: A negative reported value is invalid for this assessment. Review blanks, calibration, calculations and reporting with the laboratory; obtain a valid result before assessment.
measures.treatment_if_measure_above_upper_bound: Evaluate chemical precipitation with solid separation, followed by selective ion exchange or adsorption if polishing is required. Check metal speciation and complexing agents, determine operating conditions through treatability tests, and manage metal-bearing sludge and spent media appropriately.

measures.name: silver_total
measures.label: Silver (Ag)
measures.description: Silver (Ag) in the wastewater sample; use the stated reporting basis.
measures.treatment_if_measure_below_lower_bound: A negative reported value is invalid for this assessment. Review blanks, calibration, calculations and reporting with the laboratory; obtain a valid result before assessment.
measures.treatment_if_measure_above_upper_bound: Evaluate silver recovery, precipitation or selective ion exchange according to chemical form and complexing agents. Manage recovered silver and spent media appropriately.
measures.limit_source: CEA Gazette No. 2264/17 (2022), Schedule I, List IIIA

measures.name: selenium_total
measures.label: Selenium (Se)
measures.description: Selenium (Se) in the wastewater sample; use the stated reporting basis.
measures.treatment_if_measure_below_lower_bound: A negative reported value is invalid for this assessment. Review blanks, calibration, calculations and reporting with the laboratory; obtain a valid result before assessment.
measures.treatment_if_measure_above_upper_bound: Determine selenium speciation. Evaluate suitable adsorption or reduction-based treatment through testing, since selenite and selenate behave differently.
measures.limit_source: CEA Gazette No. 2264/17 (2022), Schedule I, List IIIA

measures.name: dissolved_phosphate_as_p
measures.label: Dissolved phosphate (as P)
measures.description: Dissolved phosphate (as P) in the wastewater sample; use the stated reporting basis.
measures.treatment_if_measure_below_lower_bound: A negative reported value is invalid for this assessment. Review blanks, calibration, calculations and reporting with the laboratory; obtain a valid result before assessment.
measures.treatment_if_measure_above_upper_bound: Evaluate alum or ferric precipitation with flocculation and solid separation. Determine dose by jar testing, check alkalinity and final pH, and manage phosphorus-bearing sludge.

measures.name: tkn_as_n
measures.label: Total Kjeldahl nitrogen (as N)
measures.description: Total Kjeldahl nitrogen (as N) in the wastewater sample; use the stated reporting basis.
measures.treatment_if_measure_below_lower_bound: A negative reported value is invalid for this assessment. Review blanks, calibration, calculations and reporting with the laboratory; obtain a valid result before assessment.
measures.treatment_if_measure_above_upper_bound: Measure ammonia and organic nitrogen separately. Evaluate ammonification and nitrification followed by nitrogen removal where needed. Nitrification alone converts nitrogen to nitrate rather than removing total nitrogen.

measures.name: ammoniacal_nitrogen_as_n
measures.label: Ammoniacal nitrogen (as N)
measures.description: Ammoniacal nitrogen (as N) in the wastewater sample; use the stated reporting basis.
measures.treatment_if_measure_below_lower_bound: A negative reported value is invalid for this assessment. Review blanks, calibration, calculations and reporting with the laboratory; obtain a valid result before assessment.
measures.treatment_if_measure_above_upper_bound: Evaluate zeolite ion exchange for suitable low-flow streams or biological nitrification after checking toxicity, alkalinity and aeration requirements. Measure nitrate formed during nitrification and evaluate further removal where needed.

measures.name: nitrate_as_n
measures.label: Nitrate (as N)
measures.description: Nitrate (as N) in the wastewater sample; use the stated reporting basis.
measures.treatment_if_measure_below_lower_bound: A negative reported value is invalid for this assessment. Review blanks, calibration, calculations and reporting with the laboratory; obtain a valid result before assessment.
measures.treatment_if_measure_above_upper_bound: Evaluate anoxic biological denitrification or nitrate-selective ion exchange. Check carbon availability for biological treatment and arrange management of spent regenerant where ion exchange is used.

measures.name: cyanide_as_cn
measures.label: Cyanide (as CN)
measures.description: Cyanide (as CN) in the wastewater sample; use the stated reporting basis.
measures.treatment_if_measure_below_lower_bound: A negative reported value is invalid for this assessment. Review blanks, calibration, calculations and reporting with the laboratory; obtain a valid result before assessment.
measures.treatment_if_measure_above_upper_bound: Segregate cyanide-bearing waste and refer treatment to a competent specialist. Evaluate controlled alkaline oxidation for the identified cyanide species; do not acidify cyanide waste. Confirm destruction and check by-products before discharge.

measures.name: total_residual_chlorine_as_cl2
measures.label: Residual chlorine (as Cl₂)
measures.description: Residual chlorine (as Cl₂) in the wastewater sample; use the stated reporting basis.
measures.treatment_if_measure_below_lower_bound: A negative reported value is invalid for this assessment. Review blanks, calibration, calculations and reporting with the laboratory; obtain a valid result before assessment.
measures.treatment_if_measure_above_upper_bound: Evaluate controlled chemical dechlorination or suitable activated carbon treatment. Verify total residual chlorine after treatment and avoid excessive reducing-agent addition.

measures.name: chloride_as_cl
measures.label: Chloride (as Cl)
measures.description: Chloride (as Cl) in the wastewater sample; use the stated reporting basis.
measures.treatment_if_measure_below_lower_bound: A negative reported value is invalid for this assessment. Review blanks, calibration, calculations and reporting with the laboratory; obtain a valid result before assessment.
measures.treatment_if_measure_above_upper_bound: Evaluate reverse osmosis or electrodialysis with suitable pretreatment. Conventional settling and biological treatment do not reliably remove dissolved chloride; plan concentrate disposal.

measures.name: fluoride_as_f
measures.label: Fluoride (as F)
measures.description: Fluoride (as F) in the wastewater sample; use the stated reporting basis.
measures.treatment_if_measure_below_lower_bound: A negative reported value is invalid for this assessment. Review blanks, calibration, calculations and reporting with the laboratory; obtain a valid result before assessment.
measures.treatment_if_measure_above_upper_bound: Evaluate activated alumina adsorption or reverse osmosis according to pH, competing ions and fluoride concentration. Validate performance and manage spent media or concentrate.

measures.name: sulphide_as_s
measures.label: Sulphide (as S)
measures.description: Sulphide (as S) in the wastewater sample; use the stated reporting basis.
measures.treatment_if_measure_below_lower_bound: A negative reported value is invalid for this assessment. Review blanks, calibration, calculations and reporting with the laboratory; obtain a valid result before assessment.
measures.treatment_if_measure_above_upper_bound: Evaluate controlled oxidation or iron precipitation with solid separation. Prevent acidification and hydrogen sulphide release; use a specialist-designed treatment and ventilation arrangement.

measures.name: sulphate_as_s
measures.label: Sulphate (as S)
measures.description: Sulphate (as S) in the wastewater sample; use the stated reporting basis.
measures.treatment_if_measure_below_lower_bound: A negative reported value is invalid for this assessment. Review blanks, calibration, calculations and reporting with the laboratory; obtain a valid result before assessment.
measures.treatment_if_measure_above_upper_bound: Confirm that the result is expressed as sulphur, rather than sulphate-ion mass. Evaluate reverse osmosis or specialist biological sulphate reduction with subsequent sulphide management and residue disposal.
